title: EVM smart-contract vulnerability classes
steps: Identify the Solidity version, constructor/initializer, owner/role checks, and the exact win condition.
Trace every external call and value transfer; check reentrancy and `delegatecall`/proxy storage collisions.
Check integer rounding/decimals, oracle/price assumptions, signature replay/nonce, and uninitialized implementation.
Reproduce with a Foundry test or `cast` against anvil; minimize to one transaction path.
falsifier: No external call/value path, correct access control, and the win condition is unreachable from the attacker role.
